'''2000 Quebec Provincial Championship Yannick Lapointe Qc Championship winner deck''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2000 Quebec Provincial Championship]]. The DeckTech post (30 March 2000) is titled 'Qc Championship winner deck' and describes it as a 'throne room start with a twist'; no date, place or record is given.<ref name="dt-4883">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4883 Qc  Championship winner deck], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 30 March 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4883/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4883/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018191059/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4883/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Qc  Championship winner deck'''
* '''Author:''' Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe
* '''Published:''' March 30, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' throne room start with a twist

=== Strategy ===

just get your twix site as fast as you can go battle where he is and during late game deploy all your cc site get pucumir + other character and finish him run luke run is tech, its not only a counter to duel it can bring luke in a fight and its not a react so if he attack your lone pucumir bring a character with POLR and luke with run luke run + its a 6 destiny cc is key its indoor so you dont fear AT and if you wondering why there is no TT well its because we are both loosing from it so it does matter because i will retrieve it and  CHYBG and secret plan dont hurt because i have no problem having my 2 battleground and when you activate 20 paying 5 for a retrieve change nothing at all
